# Voice Control sub-actions

## Set Voice Control Command

Changes the phrase of a Voice Control command, or makes a new command. Handy to change what you must say, for example one phrase per game.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Command** | The name of a voice command from the Voice Control page, like "Switch scene". |
| **Command phrase** | The words to listen for, like "scene gaming". You can use %variables%. |
| **Location** | Where the phrase can be in your sentence. Exact = it must be everything you say. Start = at the beginning. Anywhere = anywhere. Unchanged = keep the current setting. Options: Unchanged, Exact, Start, Anywhere. Starts as: `Unchanged`. |
| **Create the command if it doesn't exist** | Tick to make the command if it does not exist yet. Unticked, a missing command gives an error. Starts as: `false`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%voiceCommandName%` | The name of the command |
| `%voiceCommandPhrase%` | The phrase it now listens for |

<small>Type id: `voiceControl.setCommand`</small>

## Set Voice Control Command State

Turns a Voice Control command on or off, or flips it. A turned-off command is ignored when you say it.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Command** | The name of a voice command from the Voice Control page. |
| **State** | Enabled turns it on. Disabled turns it off. Toggle switches to the opposite. Options: Enabled, Disabled, Toggle. Starts as: `Enabled`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%voiceCommandEnabled%` | True if the command is on now |

<small>Type id: `voiceControl.setCommandState`</small>

## Set Voice Control Input

Chooses which microphone Voice Control listens to. Handy if you have several microphones. It works right away, also while listening.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Audio Input Device** | The microphone's name, picked from the list. Default = your computer's normal microphone. Starts as: `Default`. |

<small>Type id: `voiceControl.setInput`</small>

## Start/Stop Listening

Starts or stops Voice Control listening to your microphone. Good for a push-to-talk hotkey, so your commands are only heard when you want.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **State** | Start begins listening. Stop ends it. Toggle switches to the opposite. Options: Start, Stop, Toggle. Starts as: `Start`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%voiceControlListening%` | True if Voice Control is listening now |

<small>Type id: `voiceControl.setListening`</small>
